exposure: Epidermolysis bullosa (EB) with congenital absence of skin (CAS)
Pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants in PLEC, LAMC2, KRT5, ITGB4, COL7A1 genes
outcome: Clinical features (generalized skin involvement, localized defects, severe skin manifestations, congenital cloudy cornea, pyloric atresia, partial esophagogastric obstruction, anuria due to vesicoureteric obstruction)
Genetic defects (identification of novel and known pathogenic variants)
cohort: The study included five patients affected by Epidermolysis bullosa with congenital absence of skin (EB with CAS).
finding: The study identified four novel and two known pathogenic/likely pathogenic variants in five distinct genes (PLEC, LAMC2, KRT5, ITGB4, COL7A1) in patients with EB with CAS, revealing extremely rare phenotypes and extending the genotypic spectrum of EB-related genes.
